privacy_desc: Privacy Policy for Piyuo Counter application
privacy_intro_body: Welcome to Piyuo Counter ("App"), provided by Piyuo ("we," "us," "our"). Effective Date: July 16, 2026. Piyuo Counter uses your device's camera and an on-device AI model to count pedestrians and vehicles. Privacy is central to the App's design: video, images, and audio are processed only on your device and never leave it. This policy explains how we handle data both for people who operate the App ("Operators") and for pedestrians/vehicles the camera happens to see ("Passersby").
privacy_how_it_works_title: How the App Processes Camera Data
privacy_how_it_works_body: The App detects and tracks objects in real time using an on-device object detection model and a tracking algorithm (BOT-SORT); video frames are analyzed only in memory and immediately discarded — never saved or transmitted. The App does not use a Re-ID (re-identification) model. No biometric embeddings or identifying features of any kind are generated, stored, or used to recognize an individual — objects are tracked using only their position and motion across nearby frames.
privacy_data_body: Instead of tracking individuals in real time, the App summarizes results into a "Payload" every 5 minutes — for example, 7:00–7:05 AM: 2 passersby, 1 entry, 1 exit, average dwell time 22 seconds. A Payload contains only these aggregated, anonymous statistics; it never contains video, images, audio, biometric data, or GPS/location data of any kind, and cannot identify any specific person. We do not collect, save, or upload GPS coordinates or any other location data — the App and any camera location it's used at remain anonymous to us. We do not integrate any third-party analytics or advertising services, and we never sell or share this data with advertisers or other third parties.
privacy_storage_body: Unless [Local Device Only] mode is on, the App uploads accumulated Payloads once per hour (e.g. all 12 Payloads from 1:00–2:00 AM upload together at 2:00 AM); if upload fails, Payloads stay on the device and retry next cycle. You choose the destination: Piyuo Cloud (piyuo.com), which retains data for 1 month unless you subscribe for longer retention, or your own private server, whose retention is entirely up to you — in that case we never receive or access your data. [Local Device Only] mode means exactly that: even the summarized, anonymous foot traffic Payloads never leave your device — not to Piyuo Cloud, not to your own server, not anywhere. They simply stay on your device for 7 days and are then automatically deleted. Data in transit to Piyuo Cloud is encrypted; data on your device is protected by your device's own security.
privacy_rights_body: Because the App never identifies anyone — camera data is processed only in real time and discarded, and uploaded data is limited to anonymous aggregate counts — it does not knowingly collect personal data from anyone, including children under 13 (or 16 in some EU countries), consistent with COPPA, GDPR, and similar laws. For the same reason, GDPR-style rights (access, correction, deletion) generally do not apply to Passersby, since we hold no data that could identify them. If you deploy the App in a public space, you (the Operator) remain responsible for any local notice/signage requirements for camera use at that location.
privacy_contact_title: Contact Us & Changes to This Policy
privacy_contact_body: Questions about this Privacy Policy can be sent to service@piyuo.com or via https://piyuo.com. We may update this policy from time to time; changes will be posted in the App or on our website and take effect once posted, so please check back periodically.
